attributes.name: ypy-switch
attributes.description: Shows this part of a form only while a rule about a field holds, with no request: `kind=company`, `kind=company|ngo`, `kind!=person`, or just `news` for a field that has a value (a checkbox that is checked). The field is found by name in the form that holds the part. A hidden part gets the `hidden` attribute and its fields are disabled, so they are not submitted and a required one does not block the submit.

events.name: ypy:switch
events.description: Fires on a part with `ypy-switch` when it goes from shown to hidden or the other way. Its first evaluation is silent.
